Room.title: Room
Room.description: Online multiplayer game room state synchronized across players.

code.description: 6-character uppercase alphanumeric room code matching the document ID.

playerOrder.description: Ordered list of player IDs currently in the room (max 16).

results.description: Generated shuffled sentence results once the round finishes (max 16).

RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Participant inside an online multiplayer room.

id.description: Player unique identifier matching the document ID.

roomCode.description: 6-character parent room code for query isolation.

name.description: Display name chosen by the player.

isHost.description: Whether this player is currently the room host.

submittedStepIndex.description: Highest step index submitted in the current round (-1 when none).

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when player metadata changed.

RoomAnswer.title: RoomAnswer
RoomAnswer.description: Secret player answer for one prompt step, isolated from player status docs until shuffle/results.

roomCode.description: 6-character parent room code for query isolation.

text.description: Secret answer text written by the player.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Game room state, turn step, bounded player order, and final shuffled sentences.

/rooms/{roomCode}/players/{playerId}.description: Players belonging to a room and whether they have locked in the active step.

/rooms/{roomCode}/answers/{answerId}.description: Secret answers per step and player, read only after round completion/shuffling.
